reliability.rationale: Reference0.247284m²/s² improves flexible0.262726 and persistence0.266345 across three held weeks. Improvement is modest; slightly better post-hoc candidate errors are appropriately not selected.

mechanism.rationale: PositiveU³ and negativeE^(3/2) terms are compatible with a production/dissipation-shaped discrete map. Coefficients have s/m units and absorb30min; shared sensors, omitted buoyancy/advection and averaging prevent physical closure identification.

novelty.rationale: Prior physical/statistical families are disclosed. This bounded literature check does not certify new laws or exhaustive novelty.

significance.rationale: Useful reproducible prediction or informative failure within a precisely scoped cohort; no automatic discovery score.

reproducibility.rationale: Inspected executable equation, coefficients, source/task definitions and saved group results; independent numerical execution belongs to the separate computational reviewer.

impact.rationale: No independent intervention, deployment-cost study or external experimental replication.

checks: Positive proposal separated from negative evidence
Primary-source context checked through public source pages; no new numerical assets acquired
limitations: One winter station, three dependent held weeks, quality-conditioned author-derived TKE. The source publication addresses snow redistribution, which this forecast does not measure.
Scientific-critical agent review is advisory; it is not human expert adjudication or independent experimental replication.
recommendations: Validate fixed coefficients across seasons/locations and independent flux measurements; investigate nonnegative/clipping behavior outside the fitted energy range without claiming a new turbulence law.
